select field.name, environment_record.category, environment_record.value, environment_record.create_time date from environment_record, field
environment_record.field_id = field.id
and field.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and environment_record.category like concat('%', #{category}, '%')
and environment_record.create_time between #{begin} and #{end}
order by date desc

select field.id id, name, province, city from area, field
field.area_id = area.id
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and province like concat('%', #{province}, '%')
and city like concat('%', #{city}, '%')
